name: Pilot
summary: Consultant Patrick Jane, Senior Agent Teresa Lisbon and her team investigate the double murder in Palm Springs of a pro golfer's wife and her doctor, which has the hallmarks of a serial killer with a personal connection to Jane.

name: Red Hair and Silver Tape
summary: While Lisbon and her team investigate the murder of a young waitress in the Napa Valley, Jane goes behind Lisbon's back to orchestrate his own undercover operation using Van Pelt as bait.

name: Red Tide
summary: When a high school girl's body washes up on the beach, Patrick Jane sets a mentalist trap in order to get her surfing friends to turn on each other and reveal what really happened.

name: Ladies in Red
summary: When the team learns that a wealthy investment banker found murdered inside his locked safe room was living a dual life and skimming millions from clients, Patrick Jane sets up a mental conundrum to see which of the suspects will show their true colors.

name: Redwood
summary: When a girl is found covered in blood and holding the murder weapon that killed her best friend, she becomes an obvious suspect, though she can't remember anything. But Jane, believing she's innocent, engineers a risky maneuver in which she must relive the terrifying events in order to spark her memory.

name: Red Handed
summary: While investigating the case of a murdered casino owner, Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to ultimately entrap the killer, and win big at the card tables.

name: Seeing Red
summary: Intent on proving a so-called psychic is a fraud - as well as a killer - Patrick arranges a séance to expose the murderer.

name: The Thin Red Line
summary: While the police suspect a drug dealer on trial is behind the murders of the State's witness in his case, as well as his girlfriend, Patrick Jane sees a different motive for the crime, as well as a different suspect.

name: Flame Red
summary: When the CBI uncovers three arson cases, Patrick Jane suspects the only surviving member of a National Guard unit of murdering his friends, and goes undercover to prove it.

name: Red Brick and Ivy
summary: When a leading scientific researcher is killed by poisoning, Patrick Jane takes a personal interest in the case when he learns the prime suspect is the victim's wife, and Jane's former psychiatrist.

name: Red John's Friends
summary: Patrick Jane, enticed by the promise from a convicted murderer that he'll reveal information about Red John upon his release, becomes singularly focused and quits the CBI in order to prove the prisoner is innocent.

name: Red Rum
summary: When a young football talent from a small town appears to have been killed in a black magic sacrifice ritual, the CBI investigation focuses on a self-proclaimed Wiccan witch, whose cat was allegedly tortured and killed by the victim prior to his death.

name: Paint It Red
summary: While it appears obvious that a business tycoon's son-in-law was in on the robbery of a $50 million painting since his body is found where the painting once hung, Patrick Jane suspects others, including a Russian oil baron, an art forger, and an art curator of being involved.

name: Crimson Casanova
summary: With Patrick Jane's help, Cho goes undercover as a ladies' man with all the right moves in order to catch a killer who has his own set of pseudo-mentalist techniques.

name: Scarlett Fever
summary: As Jane and the team investigate the poisoning death of the "queen bee" in a country club, they discover that the community is full of secrets, including love affairs and drug abuse.

name: Bloodshot
summary: Patrick Jane must rely on his other senses during the murder investigation of a financial advisor when he loses his sight as a result of an explosion.

name: Carnelian Inc.
summary: A story of greed and betrayal pits Patrick Jane against a group of financiers when the CBI investigates a series of murders at a corporate retreat in the wilds of the Sierra Nevada foothills.

name: Russet Potatoes
summary: Patrick Jane and the CBI team track down a mastermind who hypnotizes people into doing their bidding.

name: A Dozen Red Roses
summary: Patrick Jane and the team go to Hollywood when they investigate the murder of a movie producer.

name: Red Sauce
summary: Patrick Jane and the team investigate the murder of a mobster who was in witness protection.

name: Miss Red
summary: Patrick Jane uses his mentalist skills to play suspects off each other in order to solve the case of a wealthy software company CEO found murdered on his yacht.

name: Blood Brothers
summary: Patrick Jane must find a clever way to convince the troubled kids at a wilderness program to confide in him about what really happened surrounding the death of one of their peers.

name: Red John's Footsteps
summary: Lisbon fears that serial killer Red John is drawing Patrick Jane into a trap when the CBI team investigates the murder of a young girl and the abduction of her twin sister.

name: Redemption
summary: While the unit tackles a murder case involving a woman who stole a million dollars from her employer, Jane and Lisbon learn that the Red John case has been reassigned to a new CBI team led by the straight-shooting agent Sam Bosco.

name: The Scarlet Letter
summary: Lisbon and the team work the case of a State Senator's murdered intern, while Jane simultaneously tries to find out what new information Bosco has uncovered on the Red John case.

name: Red Badge
summary: Jane, Cho, Rigsby, and Van Pelt decide to conduct their own investigation when Lisbon is accused of murdering a child molester she arrested who was recently paroled.

name: Red Menace
summary: Jane, Lisbon and the CBI team encounter one of California's most dangerous motorcycle gangs when investigating the death of their primary attorney.

name: Red Scare
summary: The CBI team investigates the death of a wealthy man living in a haunted mansion, and Rigsby and Van Pelt grow closer.

name: Black Gold and Red Blood
summary: Even after Bosco arrests Jane and puts him in prison for spying on the Red John investigation, Jane is able to help the CBI team from his cell to solve the murder of a young man.

name: Red Bulls
summary: Minelli orders Jane, Lisbon and the rest of the unit to play nice and work together with Bosco and his team to locate a kidnapped woman being held for ransom.

name: His Red Right Hand
summary: The CBI team are faced with a violent and shocking crime in their own offices, but must work the case in spite of their alarm at who may be behind it.

name: A Price Above Rubies
summary: Patrick Jane and the team are called to investigate the robbery and murder of a wealthy jeweler while attending a black tie fundraiser for the CBI.

name: Throwing Fire
summary: While Jane and the team examine the crime scene where a baseball scout is found murdered, Jane is clocked in the head by a ball and flashes back to his childhood with his overbearing father.

name: Rose-Colored Glasses
summary: Rigsby goes undercover as an alum at a 15th high school reunion when Patrick Jane and the team investigate a double homicide that may be linked to an old prank.

name: Bleeding Heart
summary: While investigating the death of a mayor's media liaison, Jane is kidnapped by an eco-terrorist who is a suspect in the case. Meanwhile, the team reluctantly agrees to be filmed for a documentary.

name: Redline
summary: Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate when the body of a high-end luxury car sales woman is found in the trunk of a Bentley in the dealership's showroom.

name: Blood In, Blood Out
summary: When a member of Cho's former gang, the Avon Park Playboys, is found murdered, Patrick Jane insists on helping Cho with his off-the-books investigation.

name: Red Herring
summary: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an arrogant chef during a cooking competition in Napa Valley.

name: Code Red
summary: When Dr. Alicia Seberg, a government research scientist, is exposed to a deadly toxin while at work and has only hours to live, she calls Patrick Jane and the CBI to find her murderer.

name: The Red Box
summary: While investogating the murder of an English tutor who stole a valuable artifact from a British museum, Patrick Jane, Lisbon, and the CBI team brace themselves to finally meet their new boss, Madeleine Hightower.

name: Aingavite Baa
summary: When a Jane Doe with amnesia and covered in blood steps in front of Cho and Van Pelt's car, Patrick Jane must use all of his skills to discover who she is, her last location, and why she lost her memory.

name: Blood Money
summary: When Patrick Jane's sneaky conduct causes the case of a confessed hitman to be tossed out of court, his annoyed CBI team must start the investigation over from scratch.

name: Red All Over
summary: When a media mogul is murdered, Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate cult leader Bret Stiles, who may have had an axe to grind following the publication of a critical story about his group.
Patrick Jane and the CBI team investigate the death of a mathematical genius by a gun-wielding clown.

name: Red Letter
summary: Romantic sparks begin to fly when Patrick Jane and supposed psychic Kristina Frye cross paths again during the CBI investigation into the murder of a charismatic head of a non-profit organization that fights human trafficking.

name: Red Sky in the Morning
summary: Patrick Jane and Kristina's first date is interrupted by a report of Red John striking again, which is discovered to be a copycat. But when Kristina reaches out to the real Red John, both she and Jane find themselves in grave danger.

name: Red Sky at Night
summary: When the CBI investigates the kidnapping of a prominent lawyer and state house lobbyist, the CBI Director wants Jane on the case, but he is uncertain of his future with the unit after his encounter with Red John.

name: Cackle-Bladder Blood
summary: When Jane's brother-in-law returns to town and gets mixed up in a murder investigation, Jane must come to his aid despite personal reservations.

name: The Blood on His Hands
summary: When Patrick Jane faces off once again with cult leader Bret Stiles, Stiles offers Jane information regarding Red John and the missing Kristina Frye.

name: Red Carpet Treatment
summary: Patrick Jane and the CBI team are called in to investigate the murder of a convict who served nine years for rape and murder, but was recently released on DNA evidence.

name: The Red Ponies
summary: Patrick Jane and the CBI team hit the horse track when a jockey is found murdered and suspects abound.

name: Pink Chanel Suit
summary: The case of a murder and missing person on an intensely secure wealthy family's compound perplexes Jane and the CBI team.

name: Red Hot
summary: Jane and the CBI team narrowly escape a fiery end when a building explodes while they're investigating a death threat. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and billionaire Walter Mashburn when they meet again while on the case.

name: Ball of Fire
summary: Patrick Jane is kidnapped and Lisbon and the team go back through years of Jane's casework to find suspects only to realize that almost everyone he's ever dealt with might want to harm him.

name: Red Moon
summary: Patrick Jane accepts the help of a local astrologer/clairvoyant, Ellis Mars, to solve the puzzling case of a triple homicide that involves two policemen and the fiancé of an EMT worker.

name: Jolly Red Elf
summary: The CBI pursues two lines of investigation when a Santa is murdered: Patrick Jane goes undercover in an AA group; and Rigsby and Van Pelt question members of an authentic Santa society. Meanwhile, following the demise of a person in custody at the CBI, J.J. LaRoche is brought in to question the team when it appears to be an inside job.

name: Bloodsport
summary: Patrick and the team investigate the murder of a woman with ties to mixed martial arts fighters. Meanwhile, LaRoche focuses his investigation on Rigsby, who in turn is forced to ask Cho for a huge favor in order to keep his job.

name: Bloodhounds
summary: When Patrick Jane and the CBI must work with a criminal profiler, Dr. Montague, to solve a double murder, it becomes a competition for Jane to prove that his methods are superior.

name: Red Alert
summary: When Patrick Jane and others are taken hostage by an armed man accused of murder, Jane must think quickly to defuse the situation.

name: Blood for Blood
summary: Van Pelt's actions are called into question when a witness is murdered while she is assigned to his protection.

name: Red Gold
summary: When a modern-day prospector is found dead near a mining site and Lisbon is injured during the initial stages of the investigation, Agent Hightower joins Patrick Jane in the field for the first time.

name: Red Queen
summary: Evidence in the murder of an antiques dealer found dead in a museum indicates that the suspect may be a member of the CBI team.

name: Bloodstream
summary: After a doctor is found dead at a golf course, the CBI team searches for a killer amongst a hospital's staff and patients. Meanwhile, when LaRoche is placed in charge of the CBI, his first act of business is to demote Lisbon, and name Cho the new team leader.

name: The Red Mile
summary: Patrick Jane and the CBI team must track down the killer of a man who believed he experienced an alien abduction - even after the victim's body is stolen from the coroner's van. Meanwhile, Van Pelt takes a break from the case to shop for wedding dresses.

name: Every Rose Has Its Thorn
summary: Patrick Jane sets out to prove a beautiful yet manipulative matchmaker shot and killed her husband after his body is found floating in the marina.

name: Redacted
summary: Patrick Jane must deal with two failed robbery attempts: one resulting in the murder of a repair shop owner and the other involving a former suspect personally hired by Jane to break into LaRoche's home.

name: Like a Redheaded Stepchild
summary: When a prison guard is stabbed to death outside of a jewelry store, Patrick Jane suspects one of the guard's inmates is the killer. Meanwhile, Rigsby questions his own father about the murder.

name: Rhapsody in Red
summary: After a young violinist is shot to death, Patrick Jane questions the members of the Northern California Symphony Orchestra about the murder. Meanwhile, Cho crosses paths with a precocious young pickpocket.

name: Strawberries and Cream, Part I
summary: Jane and the team investigate an explosion at a gas station, involving a thief with a bomb strapped to his chest. However, not everything is quite as it first appears when Jane reveals that the bomber was in fact the victim, and not the real killer.

name: Strawberries and Cream, Part II
summary: Red John's mole is finally revealed and Patrick Jane comes face-to-face with the serial killer in an explosive confrontation that leads to shocking repercussions.

name: Scarlet Ribbons
summary: In prison for killing his nemesis, Patrick Jane must prove that the man he shot really was Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon urges Van Pelt to seek counseling in the aftermath of the death of her fiancé, Craig O'Laughlin.

name: Little Red Book
summary: With Lisbon suspended and the rest of the team reassigned, Jane is reinstated as a CBI consultant and forced to work with a new team. During the investigation, Jane conspires to bring his former team back together.

name: Pretty Red Balloon
summary: When the son of a former client from Jane's days as a psychic is kidnapped, Jane and the CBI team are asked to help find him. Meanwhile, Jane butts heads with his former client's new "spiritual advisor".

name: Ring Around the Rosie
summary: Jane notices a suspicious looking man carrying a gun at a political rally and sets out to prove he's a psychopath on the brink of committing murder. Meanwhile, Lisbon investigates the death of a photographer at the same rally.

name: Blood and Sand
summary: Jane and the CBI team investigate the murder of a woman whose body washed up on an island off the coast of California. Meanwhile, Rigsby worries that his relationship with a public defender may create awkwardness between him and Van Pelt.

name: Where in the World is Carmine O'Brien?
summary: When the CBI team travels to a resort town to find out who murdered a police chief, Lisbon crosses paths with her brother Tommy, now a bounty hunter, who's tracking a bail jumper.

name: Blinking Red Light
summary: The search for a serial killer hits close to home for Jane when he encounters a blogger who has devoted his life to finding the killer.

name: Pink Tops
summary: In order to find the killer of an undercover narcotics cop, Jane and the CBI team retrace her investigation.

name: The Redshirt
summary: Jane and the CBI investigate when a retired NFL star quarterback is presumed dead after his car blows up. Meanwhile, while preparing for a court case, Rigsby and Sarah Harrigan take their relationship to the next level.

name: Fugue in Red
summary: During the search for a firefighter's killer, Jane is attacked and nearly drowned, resulting in a temporary loss of his memory and a return to his pre-CBI con man persona.

name: Always Bet on Red
summary: Jane and the CBI must narrow down the long list of suspects after a high-end divorce attorney with many enemies is killed on his speed boat. Meanwhile, Jane is questioned about whether Red John was responsible for Panzer's murder.

name: My Bloody Valentine
summary: With very little evidence, Jane and the CBI investigate the death of a mob boss' son. Meanwhile, while taking a belligerent witness in for questioning, Van Pelt is haunted by the memories of O'Laughlin's shooting.

name: Red Is the New Black
summary: Jane and the CBI narrow down the list of suspects after a disgraced clothing designer on the verge of a comeback becomes a fashion victim. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Darcy continues her investigation into finding Red John.

name: At First Blush
summary: While a jury deliberates the guilt or innocence of a defendant on trial for murder, Jane tries to prove she has been wrongfully accused before time runs out. Meanwhile, Summer may have gone too far when she helps Cho make a case against a suspect.

name: War of the Roses
summary: When a charity worker is killed, Jane has Erica Flynn, a murderer he helped imprison, furloughed in exchange for information she claims to have about the case. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Sarah try to adjust to impending parenthood.

name: His Thoughts Were Red Thoughts
summary: Jane is reunited with his former nemesis, cult leader Bret Stiles, when the head of an anti-cult activist organization is murdered.

name: Cheap Burgundy
summary: Jane suspects that Susan Darcy has ulterior motives when she asks for his help with a homicide investigation. Meanwhile, the CBI team handles the murder of a young woman who was killed after meeting someone in an online chat room.

name: Ruddy Cheeks
summary: Jane and the CBI try to narrow down the list of suspects when a terminally ill man, is found murdered. Meanwhile, Cho is forced to face his demons.

name: Pink Champagne on Ice
summary: While investigating the murder of a casino employee, Jane runs into a stage magician he used to tour with during his time as a mentalist and discovers he is hiding a shocking secret.

name: Something's Rotten in Redmund
summary: Jane and the CBI try to determine who would have reason to kill a popular English teacher, giving Jane an opportunity to show off his acting skills to a drama class. Meanwhile, Cho hides his relationship with Summer from Lisbon, and Rigsby gets a special delivery.

name: Ruby Slippers
summary: Jane and the CBI gang get involved in the world of a Drag Queen Cabaret when a body is found burned to death in the alley behind their theater.

name: So Long, and Thanks for All the Red Snapper
summary: While investigating the murder of a surfer, Lisbon reconnects with her former fiancé, Greg Tayback, who she hasn't seen in over a decade. Also, Cho questions his decision to be in a relationship with Summer.

name: Red Rover, Red Rover
summary: On the eighth anniversary of his wife and daughter's death, Jane receives a message from Red John, causing Jane to lose focus on his current case and put the investigation and his career at the CBI in jeopardy.

name: The Crimson Hat
summary: After another attempt to find Red John fails, Patrick Jane hits rock bottom at a Las Vegas club in the fourth season finale.

name: The Crimson Ticket
summary: While Jane tries to decipher Lorelei's connection to Red John, the CBI team is forced to partner with the FBI to solve the murder of a hotel employee.

name: Devil's Cherry
summary: While the team investigates the murder of a diamond cutter, Jane meets a girl who claims to be his late daughter, Charlotte.

name: Not One Red Cent
summary: A bank employee is murdered during a heist and Jane and the team must work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is pulled deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

name: Blood Feud
summary: When Rigsby's father is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a long-standing small-town gang war.

name: Red Dawn
summary: Flashing back several years, a distraught Patrick Jane arrives at the CBI to ask for evidence in the Red John investigation. However, while shadowing Libson, Jane winds up helping the team solve the murder of a judge's son.

name: Cherry Picked
summary: The team investigates the kidnapping of a couple that may be the victim of mistaken identity, while Jane continues his investigation into Lorelei's whereabouts.

name: If It Bleeds, It Leads
summary: The team investigates the murder of a reporter who may have become too close to her story, while Jane insists on pursuing his own leads to find Lorelei.

name: Red Sails in the Sunset
summary: With the help of Bret Stiles, Jane orchestrates an elaborate plan to break Lorelei Martins out of prison in the hope that she will lead him to Red John.

name: Black Cherry
summary: The CBI team investigates the murder of a real estate agent with former gang ties, while Jane searches for leads on his new connection to Red John.

name: Panama Red
summary: The death of a young botanist leads the team into the lucrative world of medical marijuana, while Cho's work with the rapid response team brings him back into contact with Summer.

name: Days of Wine and Roses
summary: The CBI team visits a high-end California rehab center in order to investigate the death of a young model who was a patient there, while Lisbon ramps up her investigation into Tommy Volker.

name: Little Red Corvette
summary: The CBI investigates the death of a geologist, which Lisbon is convinced is the key to bringing down Tommy Volker.

name: The Red Barn
summary: Jane and the CBI team investigate a 25-year-old case that seems to connect Red John with members of the Visualize cult, and Lisbon contemplates her future.

name: Red in Tooth and Claw
summary: The team delves into the surprisingly cut-throat world of academics in a case involving a graduate student at a natural history museum, and Jane helps Bertram improve his poker game.

name: Red Lacquer Nail Polish
summary: Jane and the team investigate the murder of an elderly heiress whose remains are found in the living room of her spooky mansion.

name: There Will Be Blood
summary: Lorelei Martins returns, determined to find out if Red John had a role in her sister's death, and Jane is forced to confess to Lisbon his part in Lorelei's prison escape.

name: Red, White and Blue
summary: The CBI team investigates when the body of a female army medic who worked with soldiers with PTSD is found near a military base.

name: Behind the Red Curtain
summary: The CBI team investigates when the young lead of a local theater production dies on the eve of the opening. Meanwhile, Jane hopes to get more information about Red John from the comatose Jason Lennon.

name: Red Letter Day
summary: The CSI team heads out to a run-down Wild West tourist town when the owner is found dead. Meanwhile, Kirkland tries to find out how much Jane knows about Red John.

name: Red Velvet Cupcakes
summary: Rigsby and Van Pelt go undercover as a couple with relationship problems to investigate the death of a woman who received advice from a radio love doctor.

name: Red and Itchy
summary: LaRoche personally requests Jane's help when the mysterious container he's been hiding for nine years is stolen from his home.

name: Red John's Rules
summary: Just as Jane narrows down the Red John suspect list to seven, Red John strikes at a victim with links to Jane's past.

name: The Desert Rose
summary: Jane and Lisbon secretly continue their dangerous mission to narrow down the list of seven Red John suspects as they investigate the murder of a man who was missing for two years.

name: Black-Winged Redbird
summary: Jane discovers an important clue to Red John's methods as the team encounters four of the suspects, and the CBI investigates the case of a software engineer killed by a drone strike.

name: Wedding in Red
summary: Jane gets the CBI involved in a murder case in Napa in order to investigate Sheriff McAllister, while Rigsby and Van Pelt contemplate their future in light of a new office policy.

name: Red Listed
summary: When Jane reveals that a list of fake Red John suspects he planted was stolen, the team races to protect those on the list before harm comes to them.

name: The Red Tattoo
summary: When a prominent member of Visualize is mysteriously killed, Jane investigates in the hopes that the case will provide a clue that will lead him to Red John.

name: Fire and Brimstone
summary: With the final clue in hand, Jane attempts to gather the remaining Red John suspects in one place in hopes of finally revealing his identity.

name: The Great Red Dragon
summary: Following the shocking events at Jane's house, the Red John list is narrowed down further, and the CBI's priority is the remaining suspects.

name: Red John
summary: Patrick Jane finally comes face-to-face with Red John, the serial killer he's tracked since the madman murdered his wife and daughter. For 10 years, Jane has doggedly hunted his nemesis in his search for justice.

name: My Blue Heaven
summary: Two years after the Red John case was put to rest, Jane's newfound peace is interrupted by a surprising job offer that could change everything for him.

name: Green Thumb
summary: The FBI reluctantly enlists Jane's help to find a missing computer programmer, but he refuses to help unless Lisbon is brought on board as well.

name: White Lines
summary: The FBI is tasked with finding the killer of several DEA agents, and Jane goes on a date with a beautiful woman associated with the case.

name: The Golden Hammer
summary: Jane and the FBI investigate the murder of a high-tech cartographer who may have unearthed a spy ring before his death. Meanwhile, Rigsby and Van Pelt find themselves on the trail of an alarming conspiracy.

name: Black Helicopters
summary: Jane's investigation leads him to join a separatist commune after a U.S. attorney is found dead in Mexico, even though there's no record of her crossing the border. Also, Rigsby and Van Pelt convince J.J. LaRoche to help them discover who is stalking former CBI members.

name: Grey Water
summary: Jane and Fischer investigate a murder at an oil fracking site, while Rigsby and Van Pelt travel to Austin to help investigate suspects in the string of attacks on former CBI team members.

name: White As the Driven Snow
summary: Grace is kidnapped by the killer who has been hunting former CBI members, but when the prime suspect appears to have an airtight alibi, Jane must rely on all his skills to locate her before time runs out.

name: Violets
summary: Jane enlists his colleagues in a dangerous sting operation to catch a deadly team of art thieves. Meanwhile, sparks fly between Lisbon and an agent from the FBI's art squad.

name: Silver Wings of Time
summary: Jane and the FBI take up the cause of a death row inmate who has two days to prove his innocence before his sentence is carried out.

name: Forest Green
summary: When a woman is found murdered near a remote men's social club, Jane must find a way to insinuate himself into the insular group to find the killer.

name: Brown Eyed Girls
summary: A chance encounter with a suspicious-looking individual leads Jane and Lisbon to uncover a vast human trafficking ring. Meanwhile, Lisbon remains tempted by Pike's offer to move to D.C. with him.

name: Il Tavolo Bianco
summary: Jane's freedom is at stake when a grand jury is empanelled to decide if he should be tried for the murder of Red John. Meanwhile, Lisbon tries to find out how Jane feels about the possibility of her leaving Austin with Marcus Pike, and Cho and Abbott follow new leads in the human trafficking ring they recently uncovered.

name: Black Hearts
summary: With time running out to save the victims of a kidnapping ring before they are transported overseas, Jane and Lisbon zero in on the criminal enterprise's mastermind. Meanwhile, Lisbon decides if she will move to D.C. with Marcus Pike.

name: Blue Bird
summary: A new lead in a cold case requires Lisbon to delay her plans to leave for Washington, D.C. with Marcus, giving Jane time to finally come to terms with his feelings for her and decide on a course of action.

name: Nothing But Blue Skies
summary: Jane and Lisbon decide to keep their new relationship a secret from their colleagues as they investigate the murder of an undercover agent. Also, young, ambitious agent Michelle Vega joins the team.

name: The Greybar Hotel
summary: Lisbon goes undercover as a prison inmate in order to get a convict to turn on her boyfriend, who is the leader of a high-end car theft ring.

name: Orange Blossom Ice Cream
summary: Jane and Lisbon travel to Beirut where they must work with former adversary, Erica Flynn, who agrees to help the FBI apprehend her boyfriend, a courier for terrorist organizations, in exchange for amnesty for her past crimes.

name: Black Market
summary: The team investigates a murder linked to a counterfeit diamond operation, but illness forces Jane to direct his colleagues from the office as he recuperates. Meanwhile, Abbott is concerned that transgressions in his past could harm his wife's chance to obtain a prestigious job in Washington, D.C..

name: The Silver Briefcase
summary: A chance encounter with a military colonel leads Jane to believe the soldier is hiding something, leading him to dig into the closed murder case of the man's wife.

name: Green Light
summary: The FBI is brought in to consult on a botched DEA raid, but when Abbott's former boss tries to blackmail Abbott into keeping the agency's missteps quiet, he is forced to choose between his career and morals.

name: Little Yellow House
summary: A murder investigation becomes personal for Lisbon when she learns that her underachieving younger brother, Jimmy, is being sought as a key witness.

name: The Whites of His Eyes
summary: Jane worries for Lisbon's safety when the team puts itself in the line of fire to protect the witness in a murder investigation from a skilled assassin.

name: Copper Bullet
summary: When Abbott's old boss, Bill Peterson, threatens Abbott's career – and possibly his freedom – Jane devises a risky plan to protect his friend's future.

name: Nothing Gold Can Stay
summary: Jane takes extreme measures as the team tries to apprehend a deadly gang of armored car robbers before their desperation to remain free costs more innocent people their lives.

name: Byzantium
summary: A young man claiming to have psychic powers offers his help to the FBI in solving a pair of murders, but when he leads them to additional victims, Jane and the team begin to suspect that he is in fact the killer they're hunting.

name: Brown Shag Carpet
summary: Jane agrees to once again pretend to be a renowned psychic and be used as bait in an attempt to lure out a serial killer and give the FBI a chance to apprehend him.

name: White Orchids
summary: Lisbon accepts Jane's surprise marriage proposal, but a killer's quest for revenge may cost them the happy ending they've worked so hard to achieve.
